question.problem:
What is the remainder when $4{x}^{3}-13{x}^{2}-35x+17$ is divided by ${x}^{2}-3x-10?$

The remainder is
{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,4x-1 \\  & {x}^{2}-3x-10\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,4{x}^{3}-13{x}^{2}-35x+17\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{4{x}^{3}-12{x}^{2}-40x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,-{x}^{2}+5x+17 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,{-{x}^{2}+3x+10}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,2x+7\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

- the quotient is $4x-1,$ and

- the remainder is $2x+7.$
